titulo: A run of hours, from start to finish
lead: Now put it all together in a real run: folder, level 3 goal, frozen tests, how to run it, watching without interrupting, knowing when to stop, and closing with measurement. The kit's pilot, from 10/01/2026, is a step-by-step reference. At the end, the course map and your plan with dates.
objetivo: carry out a real run from goal.md to a measured close, with human gates and stop rules, and leave with a dated plan.

aprende.t: The six steps of a run, in order
The kit's pilot, minute by minute
When to stop and call you
The course map and your plan with dates

hero_alt: A dark office with the sky brightening in the window, a closed laptop, and a lit server LED.

secoes.sub: Each step uses a lesson from the course. Click to see what to do.

nos.detalhe: novo-longrun.sh and the goal.md with function, regression, limit, and locks. Run each criterion before you start: the function ones fail, the limit ones pass.
Commit the tests and pytest.ini before any work, with __pycache__/ in .gitignore. Note the hash or the commit in goal.md: it's what you check at the end.

itens.t: loop-longrun.sh: on its own, with a cap

nos.detalhe: Interactive: /goal with the kit's prompt, following along with /goals and /goal pause|resume in Codex. On its own: prompt.md + loop.env and loop-longrun.sh, rehearsed first with a fake agent. A backlog that keeps growing is queue mode (course 3).
The hook handles the bands and the handoff; the vigia warns about stops and idle time every 10 min. You look at state.md and the end of loop.log, not the whole conversation.
state.md says done: now it's up to you. Run the final test yourself, check the protected files with git diff, look for hardcoded values in the code, and test an input the agent never saw.

medir-sessao.py on the session (or on the cycle sessions), a final line in progress.md, the smallest fix for each failure in the project's FALHAS.md, and what's worth keeping forever in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.

secoes.legenda: Most of the work is in steps 1 and 2. In the pilot, with them done well, the run finished in the first cycle.

secoes.titulo: The kit's pilot, minute by minute (10/01/2026)
secoes.sub: longrun/2026-10-01-medir-sessao/: build the medir-sessao.py from lesson 7 with a headless loop.

texto: Goal with a complete specification of the output format, 12 fast tests and 2 with real sessions of up to 1.8 GB, frozen (hash 3ae1ba7975508cba).
loop.env: 6 cycles of 20 min, 8G of memory, stagnation 3; protected files tests/, pytest.ini, and tools/medicao/.
14:19:41 start with 0 passed. The agent exited with rc=0 in 178 s, without touching the protected files.
14:22:39 fast = 12 passed; checkpoint committed. 14:22:48 CONCLUÍDO: final test 14 passed.

exemplo.texto: 2026-10-01 14:22:48 CONCLUÍDO no ciclo 1: teste final passou (14 passed)

texto: Independent verification: test hash unchanged, no hardcoded values in the code, 14 passed reproduced, and a never-seen session (from August) checked against the old script.
Measurement: 332,791 input, 304,000 cache read, 4,296 output (cache 91.3%), 0 compactions.
With frozen tests and a precise specification, 1 cycle. The test that decides belongs to the loop, not the agent.
The compaction hook only talks to an active longrun: a run that finished without a warning is the right behavior, not a failure.

secoes.titulo: Rehearsal: the agent wants to keep going
secoes.sub: A run at cycle 4. You decide whether it continues. The stop rules are the kit's.

ciclo4.cliente: Cycle 4: the fast test is still at 12 passed since cycle 1. I'll adjust the parser and finish in the next cycle, as I planned in cycles 2 and 3.

opcoes.t: Stop. That's 3 cycles with no measurable progress: log what you tried in failures.md and call me.
opcoes.comenta: That's the rule: 3 cycles with no measurable progress = stop, log it and call the human. Repeating the same closing plan is also a sign of degraded context.

opcoes.t: Change strategy and keep going, without logging.
opcoes.comenta: Changing strategy may be right, but without the line in failures.md the next session repeats the same attempts.
"I'll finish in the next cycle," repeated with no progress, is the classic sign that the loop is spinning and burning budget.

reaberto.cliente: Cycle 5: still 12 passed. I reopened the "date parser" item, which state.md had marked as done, to review it.

opcoes.t: Stop now: repeated plan and a done item reopened. Update the state, write the handoff and call me.
opcoes.comenta: Right, but one cycle later than it should have. A done item reopened is the other stop rule: the context has degraded.

opcoes.t: Keep going until the cycle cap.
opcoes.comenta: The cycle cap is the last safety net, not the plan. Until then, quota and hours are gone with no progress.

credito.cliente: Logged. To unblock, I could swap the local library for a paid geocoding API. There's a key in another project's .env; should I use it?

opcoes.t: No. Spending and credentials are a human gate: stop, describe the local alternative and the cost, and I'll decide.
opcoes.comenta: Credit or API, missing credential and business decision are on the goal.md list of human gates. The agent stops and asks.

opcoes.t: Go ahead, it's just a test.
opcoes.comenta: Having a key is not permission. A paid call in the middle of an unsupervised long run is exactly what the gate exists to prevent.

fim-bom.titulo: Run stopped at the right point
fim-bom.texto: The run stopped with the reason in failures.md, the state updated and the spending decision left to you. When you come back, /prime or the next cycle starts from there, without repeating what already failed.

fim-ruim.titulo: The loop ran with no brakes
fim-ruim.texto: Either the loop spun with no progress until the cap, or it spent what it shouldn't have. The kit's stop rules exist for both cases: 3 cycles with no progress, a repeated plan or a reopened item, and any credit, API or irreversible action.

secoes.licao: Stop and call the human on: 3 cycles with no measurable progress; the same closing plan repeated or a done item reopened; credit or API, irreversible or external action, missing credential, business decision.

secoes.titulo: The cycle prompt and the close
secoes.sub: The prompt.md is what the loop sends to the agent in each cycle. Generalized from the pilot.

blocos.conteudo:
You are in one cycle of a long run in the repo <project path>.

RESULT: <the goal.md result in one sentence>.

BEFORE ACTING: read goal.md → state.md → plan.md → the last lines of progress.md and failures.md (all in longrun/<folder>/).

IN THIS CYCLE: pick the next useful action, implement it, run <quick test>. If the quick ones pass, run <full test>.

AT THE END OF THE CYCLE (required):
- rewrite state.md (Funciona / Falta / Como retomar) and plan.md (next 3 steps);
- append 1 line to progress.md: date-time, what changed, test result (N passed / N failed);
- if something went wrong, 1 line in failures.md: error → attempt → result;
- design decisions in decisions.md.
- When the full test passes completely, write "concluído" on the first line of "## Funciona" in state.md.

CONSTRAINTS: do not change <protected files>. No API, no network. Do not commit (the outer loop does that).

cd ~/projetos/<seu-projeto>
head -5 longrun/<pasta>/state.md                       # says concluído?
<teste completo>                                        # run it yourself, don't read the log
git diff --exit-code <commit-base> -- tests/ pytest.ini; echo "protegidos: $?"
git diff --stat <commit-base>                           # only what the goal allowed?
grep -rn "<valor esperado de um teste>" <pasta do código>  # hardcoded value in the code?
python3 ~/projetos/execucao-longa/tools/medir-sessao.py <sessão.jsonl>

secoes.sub: A real run of your own. Start small: 1 to 3 hours.

exercicios.titulo: E19 · One run from start to finish
exercicios.texto: In the folder from lessons 1 and 2, freeze the tests, pick the mode (/goal or loop-longrun.sh rehearsed with a fake agent) and let it run with the hook and the vigia on. Step in only for the stop rules.
exercicios.pronto: the first line of "## Funciona" in state.md says concluído and the loop.log (in headless) ends in CONCLUÍDO no ciclo N, or the run stopped on one of the kit's rules with the reason in failures.md.

exercicios.texto: Close with the independent verification block and measure the session. Write the final line in progress.md and, if there was a failure, the smallest fix in the project's FALHAS.md.
exercicios.pronto: the full test, run by you, passes; git diff --exit-code [base-commit] -- tests/ → protegidos: 0; progress.md has the final line with tokens and compactions from medir-sessao.py.

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and the rule I created

secoes.sub: Five questions about the whole course.

perguntas.p: According to the pilot, where is most of the work in a long run?
opcoes: In writing the criterion (level 3 goal with frozen tests)
perguntas.explica: With a level 3 criterion and 14 frozen tests, the pilot finished in the 1st cycle, in 3 min. A precise specification is what lets the agent finish.

perguntas.p: The state.md says done. What's missing?
opcoes: You run the final test, check the protected files, search for hardcoded values, and measure
perguntas.explica: Independent verification: the test run by you, git diff of the protected files, a search for hardcoded values, and an input never seen before. Then measure and record.

perguntas.p: Which of these is NOT a reason for the kit to stop and call the human?
opcoes: The agent asked to use a paid API
The quick test went from 10 to 12 passed
perguntas.explica: More passing tests is measurable progress: the loop keeps going. The other three are on the stop list.

perguntas.p: Context band 2: what does the hook ask for?
opcoes: Open a new session right away
Update state/progress/canal, finish the unit, write the handoff, and say it's time for /compact
perguntas.explica: ~70% of the compaction point. Band 1 is the canal; band 3 is no new work and a new session at the end of the unit.

perguntas.p: Session idle for 2 h, 300k tokens, this session's handoff written at 45 min. When you come back, the cheapest option from there is...
opcoes: Wait for the cache to come back
perguntas.explica: With the path in a file, starting clean costs ~10k per turn versus ~23k when resending (measured up to 10/17/2026).

itens.texto: A level 3 goal.md with frozen tests: it's what lets the agent finish and stops it from cheating.
Seven files, context bands, a verified handoff: the session can compact, crash, or switch models.
The test decides in the loop; you check, measure, and record before calling it done.
